instruction: Cinematic film still, full-body shot. On a shaded dirt path in a lush green forest, the dark-haired woman in a cream ruffled dress (R1) walks on the left, looking toward the right. Beside her, the short-haired woman in a white ruffled blouse and tan trousers (R2) walks on the right, pointing forward with her raised left hand. R2's left arm is linked through R1's right arm as they walk together. Soft, diffused daylight filters through the dense green canopy, illuminating the scene with natural, earthy tones.
